punch_surface_uz — DRIVE tactorque op

• Data kinds: matrix × scalar × scalar × scalar × scalar → matrix

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.punch_surface_uz(r, a: 'float', P: 'float', G: 'float', nu: 'float') -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import tactorque; tactorque.punch_surface_uz(r, a: 'float', P: 'float', G: 'float', nu: 'float') -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("punch_surface_uz"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

平頭円形押し込み子(法線力 P)の半空間表面の法線変位 [m] (沈む向き正): 円内は一様 δ = P(1−ν)/(4Ga)、外側は (2δ/π) arcsin(a/r) (Johnson 1985 §3.4 の平頭押し込み子。式番号は本文で確認できず unverified —— Boussinesq 核 Kz の畳み込みと 0.35 % で一致することで数値検証した)。Raises ValueError: a, P, G ≤ 0。
